# TalentLens EDA Summary
*Generated by Chapter 7 — Data Voyage*

## Dataset
- **Total postings analysed:** 576
- **Salary data available:** 463 (80.4%)

## Key Findings

### 1. Salary — use median, not mean
Skew = 1.17; median ₹19.3L, mean ₹20.8L,
middle half ₹13.1L – ₹26.8L (disclosed salaries only).
Long right tail (skew > 1) but the bulk is compact, so mean and median are close. Report the median and name the tail separately.

### 2. Baseline skills
The top three skills by posting frequency are **Python, SQL, Machine Learning**
(70%, 64%, 37% of postings).

### 3. Role salary premium
**AI Engineer** has the highest median at ₹23.4L,
vs Data Analyst at ₹10.2L
(2.3x).

### 4. Remote vs on-site
Remote median ₹22.0L (n=184) vs on-site ₹16.9L (n=279) — a gap to test for confounding in Chapter 8, not a finding yet.

## What this sets up
- Chapter 8: test whether the remote gap survives controlling for seniority (from the job title).
- Chapter 9: top skills and description text become the role classifier's features.
- Log-transform salary before correlation analysis (skew = 1.17).
